description: Verify that SubscribeEventgroup OptionsLen larger than message — DUT Acks or ignores
approach:
[Objective]
Tolerant: OptionsLen overshoots but DUT can still find a valid endpoint option — Acks. DUT must NOT silently fail by Nack-ing valid endpoint.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService.
2. Tester → DUT: SubscribeEventgroup with OptionsLen larger than message.
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: SubscribeAck (NOT Nack).

[Pass condition]
Observed DUT behaviour matches the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Fail_phase2_dut_nacked_oversized_options: DUT nacked on oversized options array length
